title: The Answer Was on Top
thesis_this_serves: An answer that repeats for every searcher sat on top of a stack of summaries, and the one binding text was underneath. The look has to make DEPTH the argument: top is bright and easy, bottom is dark and binding, and the camera earns the descent.

roles.sky: #B9C4B4  Kodiak fog green-gray, early fall, the marsh at 7am
roles.ground: #1F3B2D  spruce, the dark anchor and the film's binding text
roles.hero: #E8590C  hunter orange, spent ONLY on the wrong answer, the date tag, and the final loop
roles.accent: #B08A3E  dry-sedge ochre, the tag's secondary state and the marsh grass
roles.paper: #F1EBDD  summary stock, warm off-white, never pure white

palette.mood: Cool, quiet, damp and fair. Nobody is scolded. The only warm thing in a fog-green world is the answer that was wrong, so orange reads as a warning without a red alarm.
palette.divergence: 2026-09-19 was powerhouse green, sodium amber and cyan. 2026-09-23 was dusk violet, birch gold, copper and carbon. This is fog green and hunter orange over spruce with cream paper. It has no violet, no gold, no copper, no cyan and no amber. It shares a green family with 09-19 but there the green is a lit powerhouse wall and here it is desaturated fog, and the accent is an orange that neither film used.

light.time_of_day: 07:10, September 5th and after, Kodiak. Sun not yet over the ridge, then indoor lamp and phone glow for the rest.
light.direction: soft overcast from above for the marsh; a single warm lamp from frame RIGHT on the kitchen table; the phone glass lights hands from below
light.key: the answer card carries its own orange emission; everything else is lit by fog fill
light.rim: cream rim on the top edge of every sheet, so the stack reads as real bodies with thickness
light.depth_approach: A vertical stack of sheets is the world. Each sheet is a depth plane on a value ladder, 10 to 12 percent L per plane, top brightest and bottom darkest, with rack-focus blur on the planes the camera has not reached. Stage3D descent through the planes. Exteriors get far ridge at 18 percent contrast, mid at full, near foreground alder at 130 percent.

shape_language.grammar: THE THIN, LIGHT SUMMARY AGAINST THE THICK, DARK BINDING TEXT.
shape_language.why_this_story: The argument is about layers. So every summary is a thin translucent pale rectangle that floats and wobbles, and the binding regulation is a thick, matte, spruce-dark block with a spine and page edge, heavy and still. Natural forms (marsh grass, fog, snipe silhouettes) are irregular. The stack never blends with them, it lies over the land like a document does.
shape_language.the_deliberate_contrast: Thin pale floaty rectangles against one thick dark still block. Not a document layout: the camera travels through the sheets like a core sample.

casting.hero_reason: A new small composite in lib/stack.tsx: N Sheets (paper.tsx) with a translucency and value ladder, a wobble, a peel 0..1, and a base slot for the spruce binder. Not Statement (09-23) and not RunOfRiver (09-19). The throughline object is DateTag, the orange tab.
from_the_shelf: Sheet and PaperFiber (paper.tsx) for every summary sheet and the affidavit
GripHand (props.tsx) for the thumb and the hands, silhouette-only, no faces
QuestionToken (credentials.tsx) as the tag's engraving pattern reference
Nameplate/StatCard style plates (props.tsx) for quote plates
the Plate/Head/Captions pattern from Ep0923 for on-screen strings
casting.why_the_shelf_covers_so_much: The film has no character face by design. Weaver is hands and a fog silhouette because she is a private individual. The cast is paper and light.
casting.cast_freshness: hero SummaryStack differs from the last two heroes, Statement and RunOfRiver.

motion_language.how_the_world_moves: Everything thin wobbles on a spring. Everything thick is still. The camera only goes DOWN through the stack, never up, until the button loops to the open.
key_hero_moves: the orange answer card slams onto the phone glass with overshoot at 0.5s
the twin card clacks down in perfect sync with the first, a mirrored bounce
the DateTag is torn off the top sheet and slides to the bottom of the stack
the peel: a hand lifts the summaries away one by one with DocumentFlip until it reaches the binder
motion_language.blur_anticipation: 180 degree shutter on the slam and the peel; anticipation of about 3 frames before every stamp

composition.staging: 9:16 master graded; the square is derived at y 420 to 1500. Story band 500 to 1300, captions own 1336 to 1472. Sheets fill above and below the crop.
composition.focal_hierarchy: one card or tag at frame center at every key moment; the stack is the background structure
composition.negative_space: fog above the marsh; black phone glass in the hook
composition.signature_shot: S11: the camera pulls back and the whole tower of summaries is revealed sitting on one thick dark binder, with the orange tag on top and a single empty slot beside it labelled GOOGLE DID NOT RESPOND.

craft_advance.how: lib/stack.tsx SummaryStack: a value ladder per plane, rack-focus blur on undelivered planes, wobble spring, peel progress. Reusable for any story about layers of sources.
